description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for git cherry-pick operations, specifically handling scenarios involving empty commits, message handling, and options like --allow-empty-message and --keep-redundant-commits.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures the command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets a command to run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within input or files.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks the expected exit code of a command.

methods.name: test_commit_message
methods.description: Verifies the commit message of the current HEAD.
